questions.stem: A 24-year-old male patient came with complaints of nausea, vomiting, giddiness, and drowsiness since one day. On further inquiry, you find out there is a history of similar complaints in the family members who recently consumed food prepared with grains as shown in the image. What is the probable diagnosis?
